reference_geometry.guide_axes: Gminus(z)=(0,0,z); Gplus(z)=H(Gminus(z)), localz in[-80,24]. Nominal boreR21.25; actual guide is two finite half-cylinders with radial side openings.
reference_geometry.A: A=ezM dot(Gplus(z)-Gminus(z))/2 is independent ofz, because both gate axes and both guide axes have localY0.
reference_geometry.true_near_nominal_angle_bisector: N(zeta)=M(0)+tan(alpha)*A*eyM+zeta*ezM. Same-z midpoint lineM(z) is parallel but is generally NOT the exact equidistant bisector. Transverse correction does not alter axial projections.

common_variables_and_relations: At common seamX0: ||d0||<=c; d1=lambda*Rx(theta)e+v, ||v||<=c, |lambda|<=.5; oneH, not independent locator extrema.
Rotate allYZ vectors by-alpha: q0=R(-alpha)d0, q1=R(-alpha)d1, v1=R(-alpha)v. Thenq1-q0=2L*sin(alpha)*n andq1=lambda*R(alpha)e+v1.
The sameH giveslambda*cos(alpha)=(q0-v1).e. The slot longitudinal parameter is eliminated; its.5 travel is not added toZ.

Taking the support of the two necessary discs AFTER this elimination gives |A|<=c/4*(sqrt((2e_z+tan(alpha)n_z)^2+n_z^2)+|n_z|sec(alpha)). A uniform angle bound usesabs(tan(alpha)); omittedtheta consistency only enlarges the set, so this is an outer bound, not an attained extremum.
Each tip isTi,minus=p_g+e_i orTi,plus=H(p_g+e_i), with the SAME carrier/rodK_i and supportS_i as its finite guide and bearing constraints. Common-axis deviations are-A+ezM.e_i and+A+ezM.R(theta)e_i.

Local rod slope in that axial projection is bounded bytauZ=(|Rzx|+sinBetaBound*|Ryx|)/Rxx, |sinBeta|<=mountRotationChord+sin|alpha|. This rotates one actual axis; it does not add a mounting-translation norm.

Combine these projected linear forms with their sharedalpha envelope, preserving +/-A and its equality for both gate heights. Conservative scalar support islocalAxial+A. It is not oldseamNorm+oldmountNorm+guidePlay.

shared_cancellation.same_side_front_minus_rear: A cancels exactly. The projected nominal separation isLgate*cos(alpha), plus the difference of that same-side carrier errors.
shared_cancellation.opposite_side_front_minus_rear: The shared seam term is+/-2A, not two freely chosen per-gate seam errors.
shared_cancellation.common_global_drift: Any whole-assembly rigid transformation movesN, gates and ball guide together; it cancels from all expressed relations.

finite_guide_interpretation.physical_wall_limit: The datum comes from the real finite inner guide, not a display line. A cylinder-axis datum does not imply full cylindrical wall at radial side holes, nor that spheres follow the bisector exactly.
